parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system login user admin privilege 15.template: set system login user [parameter1] privilege [parameter2] class [parameter3]
set system login user admin privilege 15.command: set system login user admin privilege 15 class superuser
set system login user admin privilege 15.explanation: 配置系统登录用户的权限等级和类别。

set system logging file-messages critica.explanation: 配置系统日志文件的记录级别。

set system services ssh root-login disab.command: set system services ssh root-login disabled

set protocols ldp router-id loopback1 fo.command: set protocols ldp router-id loopback1 force
set protocols ldp router-id loopback1 fo.explanation: 配置LDP协议的router-id，并强制使用指定的loopback接口。

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: LDP协议的router-id，通常为loopback接口的IP地址。

set protocols isis network point-to-poin.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的网络类型为点对点。

set protocols ldp interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用LDP协议。

set protocols ldp interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用LDP协议。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family mp.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family mpls

parameters.name: unit

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mp.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mpls

parameters.name: unit

set interfaces lo1 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo1 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo1 unit 0 family inet address 2.2.2.9/32
set interfaces lo1 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit

set security policies from-zone Trust to.template: set security policies from-zone [parameter1] to-zone [parameter2] policy [parameter3] match-source [parameter4]
set security policies from-zone Trust to.command: set security policies from-zone Trust to-zone Untrust policy any match-source anywhere
set security policies from-zone Trust to.explanation: 配置从Trust区域到Untrust区域的安全策略，允许任何来源的流量。

set security policies from-zone Untrust.template: set security policies from-zone [parameter1] to-zone [parameter2] policy [parameter3] match-source [parameter4]
set security policies from-zone Untrust.command: set security policies from-zone Untrust to-zone Trust policy any match-source anywhere
set security policies from-zone Untrust.explanation: 配置从Untrust区域到Trust区域的安全策略，允许任何来源的流量。

set security zones security-zone Trust i.command: set security zones security-zone Trust interface ge-0/0/0.0
set security zones security-zone Trust i.explanation: 将接口分配到指定的安全区域。

set security zones security-zone Trust i.command: set security zones security-zone Trust interface ge-1/0/0.0
set security zones security-zone Trust i.explanation: 将接口分配到指定的安全区域。

set service tcp-established-timeout 1800.explanation: 配置TCP已建立连接的超时时间。
